subject_line: Your stomach hurts and you're doing everything right
opening: Hey, happy Sunday. This week we're getting into the stuff nobody talks about at dinner: the bloating, the nausea, the cravings that feel like they come out of nowhere. If your body has been sending mixed signals lately, you're not alone and you're not failing. Let's sort it out.

hero.title: Still Bloated on Carnivore Two Months In
hero.teaser: You did everything the plan said. No plants, no carbs, no cheating. And yet every evening your stomach looks like you swallowed a basketball. Most people assume they're just not far enough in, but Sarah says the real answer is almost never patience. There are three specific causes she sees over and over, and once you know which one you're dealing with, the fix is actually pretty simple.

supporting.title: How Much to Eat on Carnivore If You Barely Move
supporting.teaser: The forum says eat more, but Marcus explains why that advice has a hidden catch for people who sit most of the day.

supporting.title: Why Cravings Spike the Week Before Your Period
supporting.teaser: Sarah found a specific hormonal pattern that explains why one week a month feels like your whole strategy falls apart.

supporting.title: Bone Broth When Your Digestion Is Wrecked
supporting.teaser: Sarah lays out the exact situation where broth beats steak, and it's not as obvious as it sounds.

try_this_week: Track when the bloat hits, not just what you ate. For the next five days, write down the time your stomach feels distended and what you ate in the two hours before. Morning bloat and evening bloat point to completely different causes, and you can't fix what you haven't spotted yet.
looking_ahead: Next week we're looking at something almost nobody tracks on carnivore, and community members say fixing it cut their fatigue in half faster than any food change did.
